decisions.statement: A passage is restated where a pair says what is written instead.
Nothing here takes a passage away.
The spellings and the pairs are handed in rather than read off a page.
Every passage of every page is answered for in this one answer.
A passage is reached under the key its page type states prose under.
A field of a record is reached by the words that field states already.
A prose value under more than one record is left alone.
A prose value stating many strings is left alone.
A count handed in holds how many passages one run restates.
A run handed no count restates every passage.
One body is read once however many passages that body states.
The passages of one body are answered by one edit.
The module splicing a body is called rather than reached through a rung.
One passage refused refuses the whole.
This runs only where the model the parser reads is.

definition: every passage a banned term is written in restated in one answer
